integrity: Proof supplies exact formulas and all-rank rational factorizations; a standalone exact-rational program checks dimensions 4 to 25 and complete matrices through 12. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional point-sampling surjectivity, not coefficient-space injectivity; normalized harmonic-kernel equiangularity is not optimal packing or a spherical design claim. Full novelty is only bounded by inspected sources, not independently established.
scope: Complex degree-four spherical harmonics on the unit sphere in the real zero-sum subspace of R^n, with n integer at least four; normalized point evaluation on the positive A_{n-1} roots.
title: Three equiangular quartic-harmonic embeddings and the complete type-\(A\) root sampling spectrum
